content:
Emma C: Hi all, newbie question  I started 4/12 and there's a company holiday coming up next week. Am I eligible for holiday pay? Also my company card hasn't shown up  I paid for a relocation parking fee, can I get that reimbursed before payroll?
People Ops: Welcome Emma! :tada: Short answer: holiday pay typically applies if payroll records you as active before the holiday date. I'll double-check the payroll cutoff and post it here. For the card, you have two options: request a virtual Ramp card or submit the receipt for an off-cycle reimbursement.
Alex W: Payroll detail: cutoff is usually the Friday before the payroll run. If your hire paperwork was in before that cutoff you'll see holiday pay on that cycle; otherwise it will be in the next one. PTO accrual begins immediately but we show prorated hours on your first paycheck. DM me your employee ID if you want me to check the exact timing.
Emma C: Thanks Alex, will DM. For the off-cycle reimbursement, what's the approval flow? I need the funds sooner than next pay period if possible.
Maria L: File the expense in Concur and tag it "relocation-expense". Then send a short email to ops@redwood.com with the Concur link + receipts and mark it urgent. We can approve an off-cycle reimbursement; typical turnaround is ~3 business days after approvals. If you prefer a virtual card, we can issue one immediately once People Ops signs off.
Jamal R: Hey Emma, welcome to the team! If you need any help with paperwork or manager cc for approvals, ping me. We had the same card delay with my onboarding and Ramp virtual card saved the day.
People Ops: Checklist for you: 1) Confirm W-4 + direct deposit are set in payroll portal 2) Enroll in benefits within 30 days in the benefits portal link (check your onboarding email) 3) If card delayed, request a virtual Ramp card or submit Concur + ops email for off-cycle. I'll update this thread with the exact payroll cutoff time as soon as payroll confirms.
Emma C: Awesome, thanks everyone 49A Appreciate the quick help!
